section_summary.extract_value: This Introduction reviews the rationale for studying positive body image, focusing on body appreciation as a multidimensional construct distinct from low negative body image, and summarizes prior qualitative and quantitative findings. It outlines the aims of the present study: to place body appreciation within a model linking interpersonal and intrapersonal predictors to outcomes (depressive symptoms, intuitive eating), and to test mediation and incremental contributions of variables (the text refers to 'the present study' and to model paths shown in Fig. 1).
